I will put fertilizer on this maize plot because here around Lilongwe maize pays better when I feed it, and I have seen the same with other farmers nearby. I will use hybrid seed, keep some manure for this field because it is my own land, and I will not irrigate since I depend on the rains. For labor, my household will do much of the work, but on a plot this size I will still hire people for land preparation and weeding when the work comes all at once.
